corrections.name: empty-temporal-proof

corrections.replacement: Fail closed with a distinct no-canonical-artifacts temporal state; do not call an empty set a proven content binding.

corrections.name: backend-exact-member-content-evidence
corrections.wound: Backend result integrity still defines exact Surgery identity without the newly source-wired artifact byte-count/SHA fields, so a promotion-group member with drifted content evidence could pass an 'exists exactly' check.
corrections.replacement: Extend supporting SurgeryIdentity admission to validate exact artifact byte-count/SHA evidence while preserving promotion authority ownership in the existing backend policy.
